name: web-quality
description: Measurement-first web quality for single-page apps, tuned for React + Vite projects from the react-vite-boilerplate: one entry point, /web-quality:audit, that measures a page in a real browser and its build (Core Web Vitals, bundle budgets, response headers, accessibility, SEO), separates measured findings from hypotheses, and routes fixes to the performance, accessibility, seo and security skills.
